name: Gaea
description: The Lady's mother, who helped create and heal her.

description_citations.text: "Lady of Otaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gaea instills a portion of her power into vengeful followers after Argoth's destruction.
timeline.quote: Gaea was willing to instill a portion of her own powers into some of her more vengeful followers.

citation.text: Gaea's Avenger (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza tries to rule the air but Gaea teaches him otherwise.
timeline.quote: Gaea taught him that she controlled all the elements.

citation.text: Whirlwind (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dawar tells Lyrin the story of the making of Dominaria by Gaea and Fiers.
timeline.quote: The Otarian dwarf Dawar tells the story of the making of Dominaria to his great-grand daughter Lyrin .

citation.text: "The Myths of Magic", section "The Lady of the Mountain , by Will and Daneen McDermott". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth becomes convinced his true foe is Rebbec's spirit as the worldsoul Gaea.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth became convinced that his ultimate foe was not Urza

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona summons five portals seeking her equal; Teferi, Lowallyn, Yawgmoth, Fiers and Multani come through, and Yawgmoth's words lead her to decide to destroy the gods.
timeline.quote: Karona summoned five portals to search for her equal

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona Reborn (c.4306 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona opens portals seeking her equal, learns Gaea is the true World Soul, and falls into rage and madness, becoming a self-proclaimed goddess of magic.
timeline.quote: drove Karona to rage and madness

citation.text: "Rebirth of Karona", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza tried to rule the air but Gaea taught him that she controlled all the elements.
timeline.quote: Urza tried to rule the air, but Gaea taught him that she controlled all the elements.

citation.text: Whirlwind (Commander 2014, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nissa and the general fall, Seven catches her, but she is dragged down by Phyrexians and reaches into the ground for the Worldsoul, Gaea.
timeline.quote: Help! Help us! she called out

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Gaea's nature spirits call Nissa a meddler, then judge her and grant her power, filling her with the wrath of Gaea.
timeline.quote: Gaea has judged you

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Gaea's will transmutes fallen constructs and Phyrexians into heartwood warriors that pour onto the battlefield and push back the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Gaea's would-be destroyers now reassembled themselves

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Titania briefly becomes an avatar of Gaea during the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: briefly became an avatar of Gaea during the Brothers' War

citation.text: "Worldsoul", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians strike in hundreds of places and are turned back at Urza's Tower with Gaea's help.
timeline.quote: They were turned back at Urza's Tower with the help of

citation.text: "Coalition", section "Reformation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fiers finishes creating the spine of Dominaria, leaving his body pale and scarred.
timeline.quote: After he finished creating the spine of Dominaria

citation.text: "Fiers", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the myth, Fiers helps Gaea create the world and creates the dwarves.
timeline.quote: He created the dwarves of the plane on his own

citation.text: "Fiers", section "Myth of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani forms a new Weatherlight figurehead in the form of Gaea, using Hanna's features.
timeline.quote: Multani formed a new figurehead for the Skyship Weatherlight in the form of Gaea

citation.text: "Gaea", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Battle at Argoth Titania becomes an avatar of Gaea; the avatar dies shortly after in the Sylex Blast.
timeline.quote: Titania absorbed the essence of Argoth to become an avatar of Gaea

citation.text: "Gaea", section "Character development". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth claims Gaea was Rebbec.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth believed she was, in fact Rebbec

citation.text: "Gaea", section "Character development". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Second Phyrexian Invasion Nissa Revane communicates with Gaea and is judged worthy; Gaea aids her defending Urza's Tower.
timeline.quote: Nissa Revane communicated with Gaea and was judged worthy

citation.text: "Gaea", section "Character development". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gaea and Fiers create the Lady, who hatches from a giant stone egg heated among lava vents.
timeline.quote: The Lady was hatched from inside a giant stone egg that Fiers placed among lava vents to heat.

citation.text: "Lady of Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Lady and dwarves defeat the evil but she is gravely injured; Gaea heals her and Fiers encases her in half her egg.
timeline.quote: The Lady and the dwarves defeat the evil, but the Lady is grievously injured in the process.

citation.text: "Lady of Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The gods entrust the Lady's protection to Themis, Gardill and Balthor Stoneface with a prophecy of three summonings.
timeline.quote: entrust the protection of the Lady to the three dwarves, Themis, Gardill, and Balthor Stoneface

citation.text: "Lady of Otaria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Maro-Sorcerer", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
